subject: Otyugh
picture: An otyugh sits in a dungeon refuse pit. Official look: fat potato body, three thick legs, two long tentacles with simple spike pads, one smaller eyestalk with two eyes. Large sacks and bones as refuse, not tiny trash. Stone pit rim, ceiling, walls. Bold even black outlines on white, same look as locked I-01 and I-02. All-ages, no gore.
